newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Southeast Cement to undertake expansion.
newsitem.headline: Southeast Cement to undertake expansion.

text.p: Southeast Cement Holdings Inc said on Tuesday its board approved an expansion programme of 2.5 million tonnes per year for its unit Lloyds Richfield Industrial Corp.
The expansion project is estimated to cost ten billion pesos and is expected to be completed in 27 months, the company said.
It will include the upgrading of port facilities at the site in Cebu province, it said.
It said its foreign partner, Tong Yang Cement Corp, agreed to take up at least 1.0 million tonnes of the additional output.
Southeast Asia Cement also said Tong Yang will construct a cement service station in Batangas city, south of Manila.
The project will include two 10,000-tonne bulk silos and related facilities at an 8.5-hectare property. It is scheduled to be completed by mid-1998.
